<script>
function toggleMobileMenu() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
  var menu = document.getElementById('nav-mobile-menu');
  btn.classList.toggle('open');
  menu.classList.toggle('open');
}
document.getElementById('nav-mobile-menu').querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a) {
  a.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.getElementById('nav-hamburger').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('nav-mobile-menu').classList.remove('open');
  });
});
</script>

<script>
function blogEmailSignup(e,form){
  e.preventDefault();
  var email=(form.querySelector('input[type=email]')||{}).value||'';
  email=email.trim();
  if(!email)return;
  form.style.display='none';
  form.parentElement.querySelector('.blog-sub-ok').style.display='block';
  try{localStorage.setItem('edgeiq_lead_magnet_captured','1');}catch(x){}
  fetch('https://edgeiqlabs.substack.com/api/v1/free',{
    method:'POST',mode:'no-cors',
    headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body:JSON.stringify({email:email,first_url:location.href,source:'blog-footer'})
  }).catch(function(){});
}
</script>
